title: Official Constraint Mechanism + Primary Filing Structure Closure
rules: G2/P3 requires direct official/regulatory evidence of an operative constraint mechanism plus provider pressure context.
Provider valuation or capital-flow observations alone cannot establish canonical Constraint.
G14/P2 requires before/after structural evidence from comparable periods; one revenue-breakdown period cannot establish Reconfiguration.
Issuer filing evidence is subsystem evidence unless broader dossier-level representativeness is separately established.
All new official evidence must enter W8D-P2 merged RRE lineage before W8E-P5 may create a human-review candidate.
No W8E-P5 candidate is an RP candidate or position admission.
